headline: Sula Vineyards gets ₹1.69 crore GST demand
summary: Sula Vineyards received a GST demand of ₹1.54 crore plus penalty for FY23. The company disputes the order and plans to appeal.

headline: Mangalam Global gets NSE nod for private placement
summary: Mangalam Global Enterprise received in-principle approval from NSE to list non-convertible securities via private placement. The approval is valid for one year, subject to credit rating compliance.

headline: Shekhawati Industries gets exchange nod for promoter reclassification
summary: BSE and NSE granted no-objection for reclassifying Altius Buildcon from Promoter Group to Public category, effective November 9, 2026.

headline: Black Box to hold investor meetings in Mumbai
summary: Black Box Limited will attend investor conferences in Mumbai on November 16 and 17, 2026. Discussions will rely solely on publicly available information.

headline: Indo Farm board meeting moved to Nov 13
summary: Indo Farm Equipment Limited rescheduled its board meeting for Q2FY27 results from November 12 to November 13, 2026. The delay allows time to finalize financial statements and complete the review process.

headline: HOC shuts Kochi Phenol plant for a week
summary: Hindustan Organic Chemicals Ltd announced a temporary shutdown of its Kochi Phenol plant starting November 10, 2026, for pipeline repairs.

headline: Ashoka Buildcon wins NHAI order worth ₹865.90 crore
summary: Ashoka Buildcon received an acceptance letter from NHAI for a project worth ₹865.90 crore involving construction of an 8-lane expressway, with an expected completion timeline of 18 months.

headline: Toss The Coin H1FY27 results: PAT crashes to ₹0.35 lakh
summary: Toss The Coin Limited reported a sharp decline in profitability for the half year ended September 30, 2026. Net profit fell to ₹0.35 lakh from ₹143.37 lakh YoY as revenue dropped 11.8%.

headline: Maruti Suzuki shares parent Suzuki Motor's H1FY26 results
summary: Maruti Suzuki India filed its parent's H1FY26 consolidated results. Revenue rose 19.4% to ¥3,419.2 billion, but operating profit margin contracted to 8.5%.

headline: Repco Home Finance directors cease tenure
summary: Repco Home Finance Limited announced the cessation of Independent Directors R. Vaithianathan and Usha Ravi on November 10, 2026, following completion of their terms.

headline: Chase Bright Steel re-appoints Shilpa Dutt as director
summary: Chase Bright Steel Ltd board approved the re-appointment of Shilpa Dutt as independent director for a second five-year term during its meeting on November 10, 2026.

headline: DHP India Q2FY27 PAT jumps 353% YoY
summary: DHP India reported a 353% YoY rise in net profit to ₹526.36 lakh for Q2FY27. Revenue from operations grew 90.5% to ₹2,737.02 lakh, driven by strong demand.

headline: Piramal Finance Q2FY27 PAT jumps 67% YoY
summary: Piramal Finance reported a 67% YoY rise in Q2FY27 net profit to ₹545 crore, driven by 24% AUM growth and improved margins. The NBFC also announced upcoming investor meetings.

headline: Sarthak Industries board meeting moved to Nov 14
summary: Sarthak Industries Ltd has rescheduled its board meeting to November 14, 2026, to approve Q2FY27 results. The trading window remains closed until 48 hours after the announcement.

headline: Sri Ramakrishna Mills Q2FY27 Results
summary: Sri Ramakrishna Mills (Coimbatore) Ltd. reported standalone unaudited financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, with detailed figures available on the company website.

headline: S Chand & Co independent directors complete second term
summary: Desh Raj Dogra and Archana Capoor ceased roles as Independent Directors on November 9, 2026, after completing their second terms. Dogra exited Board Chairmanship and committee memberships.

headline: IRB InvIT toll revenue up 5% in October
summary: IRB InvIT Fund reported gross toll revenue of ₹2,003 million for October 2026, marking a 5% year-on-year increase from ₹1,901 million in the prior year.

headline: Tata Comms to host investor meets in Mumbai
summary: Tata Communications will participate in three institutional investor events in Mumbai from November 16 to 18, 2026, including forums by JM Financial and CLSA.

headline: MRF Q2FY27: Profit dips 28% YoY, declares ₹3 dividend
summary: MRF reported a 27.8% YoY decline in standalone net profit to ₹369.15 crore despite 17.6% revenue growth. The Board declared an interim dividend of ₹3 per share.

headline: Decorous Investment approves Q2FY27 results
summary: Decorous Investment & Trading Co Ltd board approved un-audited financial results for Q2FY27 on November 10, 2026. Trading window closed until November 15.

headline: Radico Khaitan discloses DRI seizure of ₹2.64 crore goods
summary: The Directorate of Revenue Intelligence seized goods worth ₹2.64 crore from Radico Khaitan over a customs tariff dispute. The company states operations remain unaffected.

headline: Riddhi Corporate approves new statutory auditors
summary: Riddhi Corporate Services approved the appointment of Aparajita V. Shah & Co. as statutory auditors to fill a casual vacancy during an EGM held on November 10, 2026.

headline: Artson CEO Shashank Jha resigns
summary: Artson Limited confirmed the resignation of CEO and Whole-Time Director Shashank Jha to pursue opportunities outside the Group. The company stated his last working day will be announced separately.

headline: Alfred Herbert Q2FY27 PAT falls 60% YoY
summary: Alfred Herbert (India) Ltd reported a standalone net profit of ₹528.89 lakh for Q2FY27, down 60.6% YoY. Total income declined to ₹758.16 lakh.

headline: Nile Ltd declares ₹3 interim dividend
summary: Nile Limited declared an interim dividend of ₹3 per share for FY27. The board also approved Q2FY27 financial results. Record date is November 17, 2026.

headline: Hirect Q2FY27 Results: Revenue up 30%, profit dips
summary: Hirect Limited reported a 29.6% YoY rise in standalone revenue to ₹2,943 crore for Q2FY27, though net profit declined slightly to ₹145 crore.

headline: Fusion Finance releases Q2FY27 earnings call transcript
summary: Fusion Finance Limited filed the transcript of its earnings conference call for Q2 and H1 FY27 on November 2, 2026. The document was submitted to NSE and BSE under SEBI regulations.

headline: Sugs Lloyd promoter buys 7,000 shares
summary: Santosh Kumar Shah acquired 7,000 equity shares via open market purchases on November 6 and 9, 2026. His holding rose to 176,000 shares (0.758%).

headline: Bansal Wire to host investor conference on Nov 16
summary: Bansal Wire Industries Limited will participate in the Avendus Spark INDX Annual Investor Conference in Mumbai on November 16, 2026. The event includes group and one-on-one sessions.

headline: Madala Holdings Q2FY27: Loss widens to ₹627 lakh
summary: Madala Holdings reported a net loss of ₹627.25 lakh in Q2FY27, driven by a sharp rise in depreciation and negative other income. Revenue from operations rose 13% YoY to ₹383.85 lakh.

headline: KIMS to host analyst meet in Pune on Nov 19
summary: Krishna Institute of Medical Sciences Ltd will participate in the Investec Pune Confluence on November 19, 2026. The company confirmed no price-sensitive information will be shared.

headline: Rossell India Q2FY27 PAT dips; board inducts two directors
summary: Rossell India reported a slight decline in Q2FY27 net profit to ₹2,728 lakh. The board approved financial results and appointed Azam Monem and Chetan Kumar Mathur as independent directors.

headline: Kesoram Industries wins ₹598.9 crore arbitral award
summary: Kesoram Industries received an arbitral award of ₹598.935 crore against Kesoram Textile Mills for loan recovery, comprising principal and accrued interest.

headline: Jayant Infratech EGM approves ₹12.57 cr acquisition
summary: Jayant Infratech Ltd shareholders approved the acquisition of Jayant Infraprojects business undertaking for ₹12,56,67,000 on a slump sale basis.

headline: Uniparts India to host investor meet at Avendus Spark INDX
summary: Uniparts India Limited representatives will meet investors and analysts at the Avendus Spark INDX event in Mumbai on November 10, 2026. The interaction includes group and one-on-one sessions.

headline: Goldiam director Ghadiali ceases role
summary: Pannkaj Chimanlal Ghadiali has ceased to be an Independent Director of Goldiam International following the completion of his second five-year term.

headline: LTTS schedules investor meetings for Nov 16-17
summary: L&T Technology Services will participate in JM Financial and Avendus Spark conferences in Mumbai on November 16 and 17, 2026.

headline: Bondada Engineering sets up UAE subsidiary
summary: Bondada Engineering Limited incorporated Bondada International FZ-LLC in UAE as a wholly owned subsidiary to drive global expansion in renewable energy and power infrastructure.

headline: Deepak Fertilisers incorporates new subsidiary
summary: Deepak Fertilisers & Petrochemicals Corp Ltd has incorporated Mahadhan Nutritek Solutions Limited as a step-down wholly owned subsidiary to expand in chemicals and agrochemicals.

headline: Cochin Shipyard declares ₹3 interim dividend
summary: Cochin Shipyard board approves Q2FY27 results and declares ₹3 per share interim dividend. Record date set for November 16, 2026.

headline: Colgate India to hold investor meetings in Nov 2026
summary: Colgate-Palmolive (India) Ltd announced participation in analyst meetings hosted by JM Financial and CLSA on November 16 and 18, 2026.

headline: Mega Nirman passes director appointments, rights issue
summary: Mega Nirman & Industries Ltd shareholders approved four resolutions via postal ballot, including three director appointments and a rights issue. Voting concluded on November 6, 2026.

headline: Oil India to host investor meet in Mumbai
summary: Oil India Limited will participate in the Avendus Spark INDX Conferences 2026 on November 16, 2026, at Grand Hyatt Mumbai. The event targets the investor group.

headline: Mahanagar Gas to hold analyst meets in Nov 2026
summary: Mahanagar Gas Limited will participate in two in-person analyst conferences on November 16 and 17, 2026. The company confirmed no price-sensitive information will be shared during these meetings.

headline: Oil India to host investor meet on Nov 17
summary: Oil India Limited will participate in the JM Financial Annual India Conference on November 17, 2026, in Mumbai. The company will engage with investors during the scheduled session.

headline: Zee Ent to attend CITI-CLSA India Forum
summary: Zee Entertainment Enterprises will attend the CITI-CLSA 29th India Forum 2026 in Mumbai on November 17, 2026. The company confirmed no price-sensitive information will be shared.

headline: Muthoot Microfin to join JM Financial India Xchange 2026
summary: Muthoot Microfin Ltd will participate in three investor conferences between November and December 2026, including JM Financial India Xchange 2026 on November 17.

headline: City Union Bank to join Trinity Asia 2026
summary: City Union Bank Limited will participate in the Trinity Asia 2026 investor conference on November 16, 2026, in Singapore, organized by 360 ONE Capital Market.

headline: Duroply Industries to host Q2FY27 earnings webinar
summary: Duroply Industries Limited will host an earnings webinar on November 16, 2026, at 2:00 pm IST to discuss its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.

stock_name: STAR IMAGING AND PATH LAB LIMI
headline: Star Imaging sets H1FY27 investor meet for Nov 18
summary: Star Imaging and Path Lab Limited will host an earnings conference call on November 18, 2026, to discuss financial performance for the half year ended September 30, 2026.

headline: D.P. Abhushan auditor resigns citing workload
summary: D.P. Abhushan Limited confirmed the resignation of statutory auditors M/s. Jeevan Jagetiya & Co. effective November 10, 2026. The firm cited capacity constraints from new assignments.

headline: NMDC in talks with Russia's Rosatom on lithium investments
summary: NMDC is reportedly in discussions with Russia's Rosatom regarding potential investments in lithium, according to sources cited by Reuters.

headline: Deccan Polypacks Q2FY27: Zero Revenue, Loss ₹3.93 Lakh
summary: Deccan Polypacks reported zero revenue for Q2FY27 with a net loss of ₹3.93 lakh. The company operates as a shell entity with no active business operations.

headline: Matrimony.com Q2FY27 profit jumps 167%
summary: Matrimony.com Ltd reported a 167% YoY rise in consolidated net profit to ₹2,073 lakh for Q2FY27. Revenue grew 18% to ₹1,348 lakh. The board also approved acquiring Astro-Vision.
